question.text: Which one of the following reactions would produce secondary alcohol

options.text: <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mover accent="false"><mo>→</mo><mrow><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub><mo> </mo></mrow></mover></math>

solution.text:
Aldehydes on reduction by LiAlH4 gives primary alcohol while ketons gives secondary alcohol. With grignard reagent ketone gives tertiary alcohol.



Also specify - successive members have different structural formula.
